text_block_list.text: Gold Ship seems strangely down today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That show I always watched,
"Bizarre! World Mystery Adventure",
has finally ended, waaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was totally scheduled to appear as one of the Seven Wonders of the World someday, too~...!
From then on, Gold Ship remained down in the dumps for a while.
